name: web
_googleClientId: Paste your OAuth client ID here — SETUP.md step 2. It looks like 1234...apps.googleusercontent.com and is public by design; there is no secret in a browser client.
_baselines: A hosted page is public: everything here is readable in the page source before anyone signs in. Ship only invented data. Real rows arrive per person, via Import a file or a first Gmail sweep.
_dropUnnamed: False: rows whose employer the sweep could not work out are offered, unticked, for you to decide. True skips them silently.
